svg.title: a freshly generated project passes its own quality gate — the toolbox ships dependencies that pass its own OSV scan
svg.text: a freshly generated project passes its own quality gate
Scenario: the toolbox ships dependencies that pass its own OSV scan

g.text: Given the maintainer checks the toolbox's shipped dependency versions
The maintainer checks the actual dependency versions shipped by the toolbox. Its base config
keeps framework dependencies in the scan.
When the maintainer uses the toolbox's own scanner configuration
The toolbox's base arguments contain "--no-resolve" and keep framework tools in the scan.
The scanner uses the live vulnerability database.
Then the toolbox's dependency scan reports no known vulnerabilities
OSV reads the toolbox's CodeceptJS lockfile and reports "No issues found". Known
